about.description: Single-stock perpetual on Variational Omni tracking CrowdStrike Holdings, Inc. (CRWD), priced off Variational Omni's OLP-aggregated mid-quotes. Users gain linear exposure to CrowdStrike Holdings, Inc. share-price moves without owning shares, shareholder rights, or dividend claims. Positions are margined and cash-settled in USDC on Arbitrum.
